- ผลการส่องกล้อง นับจากแฟ้มวินิจฉัยโรค ซึ่งแบ่งเป็น 2 กลุ่ม คือ กลุ่มผิดปกติ รหัส K51.9,K57.9,K638,K63.5 และกลุ่มที่พบมะเร็ง ICD10 ขึ้นต้นด้วย C

SET @prov_c := ( SELECT provincecode FROM sys_config LIMIT 1 );
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 IGNORE  AS

SELECT
p.hospcode,p.pid,p.CID,p.NAME,p.LNAME,p.BIRTH,p.SEX,p.NATION,p.check_typearea,p.addr,p.check_vhid,p.DISCHARGE
,t.instype,t.main,t.date_year2 fit_date,t.f_year2 fit_code,t.hospcode fit_hosp
,c.HOSPCODE colono_hosp,c.PID colono_pid,c.instype colono_ins,c.main colono_main
,c.DATE_SERV colono_date
,PROCEDCODE colono_code
,IF(PROCEDCODE IN('4523','4530021'), 'Colonoscopy',
IF(PROCEDCODE IN('4542','4532620'), 'Colonoscopy with polypectomy',
IF(PROCEDCODE IN('4525','4530439'), 'Colonoscopy with biopsy of colon',null
))) colono_type
,c.source colono_source,c.r_date,c.r_code,c.result
FROM
t_fit_test_hosp t 
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON t.HOSPCODE=p.HOSPCODE AND t.PID=p.PID 
	AND t.f_year2 IN('1B0060','1B0061')  AND t.instype IN('0100')
	AND  DATE_FORMAT(p.BIRTH,'%Y') BETWEEN (@b_year-70) AND (@b_year-50)
	AND t.date_year2 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
LEFT JOIN tmp_colonoscopy c ON t.CID=c.CID AND c.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d;
 
SELECT
h.hoscode,h.hosname,d.pid,d.CID,d.NAME,d.LNAME,d.BIRTH,d.SEX,d.NATION,d.check_typearea,d.addr
,d.check_vhid,d.DISCHARGE
,d.instype,d.main,d.fit_date,d.fit_code,d.fit_hosp
,d.colono_hosp,d.colono_pid,d.colono_ins,d.colono_main
,d.colono_date,d.colono_code,d.colono_type,d.colono_source 
,d.r_date,d.r_code,d.result
FROM tx d 
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE 1=1 {where}
